rules.statement: A right of cart way cannot be acquired by prescription over a servient tenement that does not adjoin the dominant tenement unless the intervening land is subject to some servitude, which must be of the same kind as the claimed servitude.
rules.supporting_quote: Voet uses the word �same� in the sense �of the same kind�. That appears from his illustrations. If water could be led through each of two adjoining estates, the servitude being the same, the water can be led from the farther, through the nearer, up to the dominant tenement. Similarly a servitude of passage, driving, and way can be constituted over three farms with separate owners if there was a servitude of passage, of driving, and of way respectively over each of the three farms.
